Home Effect Types Overdrive Serenity Fuzzdrive Serenity Fuzzdrive Smooth, sweet, amp-like fuzzy drive Fat and full range, but without boosting unpleasant or "congested" low-midrange frequencies You control the emphasis and balance of the prominent frequency ranges This effect is intended as a smooth, saturated lead effect, somewhat akin to Clapton's "woman tone;" a mellow, sustaining, harmonically-rich, sweet sustain that straddles the line between fuzz and cranked amp. read more reviews clips SKU: Serenity-deposit MPN: SKR-SNTY Stock Status: Preorder Delivery Status: Lead time of about 2 weeks We build everything to order. Our current wait time is approximately 2 weeks to 1 month. I will confirm your order shortly, and I will send you a PayPal invoice for the total amount due including shipping when your order is ready. --Marc Price: $259 + shipping $259 $233.10 (10% off) 50% deposit $116.55 Quantity qty Add To Cart Smooth, sweet amp-like gain that goes from cleanish boost to overdrive to compressed sustain Reviews • Sound Clips • Manual Even-handed low end; not boomy, not thin; the Body knob sets its level from fat to neutral to streamlined--emphasizing fatness and low mids most of the time, though! Turn all the way up to get the most transparent and articulate response. I generally use it as a LEAD boost and not as a foundational drive, because that's where its juiciness and saturation work best. Incredibly smooth, harmonically-rich, liquid sustain, like a mega compressor cascading into a high-gain boost, when Fuzz and Hot are cranked Low noise but clear and lively Perfectly balanced sound that carries from cleanish all the way into fuzz Class A overdrive / distortion / fuzz with no clipping diodes, no op-amps, and no active tone controls Natural EQ footprint with special attention paid to phase integrity of the audio signal The effect is a very straightforward sound that evokes the feel of your guitar plugged directly into a cooking tube amp at low gain settings and a boosted yet transparent fuzz at high gain settings. Magically flexible gain that lets the strings sing Can go from mild, open overdrive to near-infinite sustain, maintaining the guitar's clarity, sweetness, and eq footprint all along the way There is an in-between state here between fuzz and tube amp, between liquid sustain and airy articulation, between having its own voice and retaining the guitar's voice while propelling it into the high-gain realm. Controls: VOL Plenty of volume: finds unity gain around noon depending on the strength of your pickups. Lots of boost available beyond. FUZZ Adjusts the gain of the distortion section for a huge range between clean and cranked-amp-style fuzz that still holds the guitar's sound together rather than imparting its own "fuzz" tone to it. HOT Adjusts the input gain; goes from an un-colored chimey sound counterclockwise to a sustaining, compressed sound clockwise. Also adds lots more smoothness and slightly darkens the signal when turned up (due to the Miller Effect), so if you want a brighter, more articulate tone, adjust this down.
